title: morwen
description: Added morwen pattern blocks and related content.
body:
# Morwen Mod 
*Minecraft 1.20.4 | NeoForge*

---

## Basic Information
This mod adds a complete set of Morwen-themed resources and equipment. All items adopt vanilla survival progression and unique neon textures.

## Item Details
| Item Name | Category | Main Functions & Features |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Morwen Block | Decorative / Storage Block | Crafted from 9 Morwen Ingots; used for resource storage and futuristic building. May have light or particle effects. |
| Raw Morwen Block (morwenblockrough) | Raw Material Block | Bulk storage for unrefined Morwen ore. Rough texture represents its raw state. |
| Morwen Ingot | Core Crafting Material | Smelted from Raw Morwen Ore. The base material for all Morwen series items. Supports all vanilla enchantments. |
| Morwen Sword | Melee Weapon | Stronger than Diamond Sword in damage and durability. Suitable for late-game combat against powerful mobs. |
| Morwen Pickaxe | Mining Tool | High mining speed and durability. Compatible with Fortune & Silk Touch, can mine all vanilla blocks. |

---

## Compatibility Reminder
1. Runtime: **Minecraft 1.20.4 + NeoForge** only.
2. Compatible with most mainstream tech and automation mods.
3. Item balance: Stronger than Diamond, designed as a late-game equipment branch.
